Blocking someone online is like putting up a stop sign to keep them from bothering you. If someone is being mean, sending you weird messages, or making you feel uncomfortable, you can block them so they can't contact you anymore. 

To block someone, you usually need to go to their profile or the message they sent you, and look for a button that says "block" or has a picture of a person with a line through it. Clicking that button will stop them from being able to send you messages or see your posts. 

It's also a good idea to tell a trusted adult, like a parent or teacher, if someone is bothering you online. They can help you block the person and make sure you're safe. Remember, you don't have to deal with mean or weird messages by yourself. 

If you're not sure how to block someone on a specific app or website, you can ask a trusted adult to help you figure it out. And always remember, if someone is being mean or scary online, it's not your fault, and you have the right to be safe and block them.
